$comment: Hand-curated pricing facts that the machine-readable feed does not model.
Consumed by scripts/sync-pricing.ts, merged into src/cost/prices.generated.ts.
This file IS edited by hand; the generated file is not.
Each entry is keyed by the model-id prefix it applies to and is merged on
top of whatever the feed reports for that prefix.
'verify: true' asks the sync script to compare the hand-entered rates
against the feed and report any mismatch instead of silently overwriting.

windows.$comment: Promotional / dated rates. The feed always reports today's effective price with no start or end date, so promo boundaries have to be declared here or a session logged after the boundary is priced with the promo rate.

fast.$comment: Fast mode (usage.speed === 'fast') runs the same model at premium rates. Not present in the feed. Opus 4.7 fast mode was removed and is deliberately absent.

models.$comment: Models the feed omits or gets wrong. Retired models' rates are frozen - they will never change again - so they live here rather than depending on the feed continuing to carry them. verify:true means the sync script still cross-checks them while the feed has them.

claude-mythos-5.note: Project Glasswing; absent from the public feed

drop.$comment: Feed keys deliberately excluded from the generated table (matched exactly, not as prefixes). Bare generic keys like 'claude-opus-4' are dropped because as a prefix they silently mis-price sibling versions: claude-opus-4-1 is $15/$75 while claude-opus-4-5 is $5/$25. An unknown model must fall through to the flagged fallback rather than to a wrong sibling rate.
